sloka: रमतः च आनुकूल्येन ययुः संवत्सरा दश ।परिसृत्य च धर्मज्ञः राघवः सह सीतया ॥३-११-२७॥
transliteration: ramataḥ ca ānukūlyena yayuḥ saṁvatsarā daśa ।parisṛtya ca dharmajñaḥ rāghavaḥ saha sītayā ॥3-11-27॥

translations.english: Thus enjoying their stay in the hermitages, Rama, Sita and Lakshmana spent ten favourable years.
